title: AI Sway Dance Video
summary: Make an AI sway dance video from one photo: the trending sway dance effect, the exact prompt behind it and ready photos to animate. Free to try in Flick.
body_markdown:
### How do I make the AI sway dance from a photo?


Upload a full body photo of the person as the start frame of an image to video model, describe a gentle side to side sway with the feet planted and a static camera, and generate a short clip.


### What kind of photo works best for the AI sway dance effect?


A sharp, well lit photo with the whole body in frame from head to feet, the person standing and facing the camera, and some empty space on both sides works best, because the model needs room to move the hips and arms.


### Is there a free AI sway dance video maker?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, enough to try a photo and animate it into a short sway dance clip.


### Can I make two people do the sway dance together?


Yes. Use one photo with both people in full view and ask them to sway side to side together in time, holding hands or side by side, and keep the camera still so both faces stay as they are.


### Can a baby or a grandparent do the AI sway dance?


Yes. Start from their photo and ask for a smaller movement that suits them, such as a wobbly bounce with the arms out for a toddler or a gentle sway with a laugh for a grandparent.


### How do I keep the face the same in an AI dance video?


Keep the movement simple, keep the camera still, and end the prompt with same person, same outfit, same place, then generate again if the face changes during the dance.


### Can I add music to an AI sway dance video?


Yes. Make the clip first, then add a song or a beat when you post it, or generate a music track in Flick to go with it, and line the sway up with the start of the music.
